description: This file defines the LogNode interface for a logging system in an Android application, specifying how log data should be output and possibly filtered or processed in a chain of log nodes.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface for a logging system component responsible for outputting log messages, possibly chaining multiple nodes for complex logging strategies.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Method to output a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional throwable exception.
